summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus non-node, unchanged-graph, and graph-method tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass, and test/test_extras plus test/test_path.py give 123 passed, 2 skipped, 3 xfailed. mypy, black, and isort were not run because none is installed in the shared venv or on the system, and I did not install anything. Please run them before merging. Nothing was committed; the two new files are untracked.
